## What this changes

## If it touches the calculation
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] The grid was regenerated with `npm run data`, not edited by hand
- [ ] Every new policy has at least one primary source and an evidence status
- [ ] No figure is presented with more precision than its evidence supports

## If it touches the interface
- [ ] Keyboard reachable, visible focus
- [ ] No meaning carried by colour alone
- [ ] Readable at 375px wide
